details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:350-364 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The judge derives an item’s tracking project from untrusted body text without validating the item’s project binding.
  WHY: A forged `Tracking issue: #N` can route fix-up requests and verdict records to an unrelated project, where the poller may adopt the request into that project’s wave.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:170-172 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: A failed `create_issue` operation does not set `ops_failed`.
  WHY: A reissue can be reported as successful and proceed to close the original item even though no replacement was created.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:247-254 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The close handler does not stop after earlier operation failures and does not set `ops_failed` when closing fails.
  WHY: A failed replacement creation can still be followed by closing the source, and a failed close can be reported as successful.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:150-153 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: For PR items, `remove_label` runs before `dispatch_review`.
  WHY: If dispatch fails after label removal, the scanner no longer selects the PR, leaving it unreviewed and undiscoverable.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:265-269 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The PR reissue operation closes the source PR before creating a replacement issue, and does not create a replacement issue.
  WHY: The PR can be closed with no replacement implementation to run, losing the work.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:531-538 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The project tracking-issue verdict marker is posted before the planned operations run.
  WHY: If posting the marker fails, the judge returns without carrying out the unblock operation even though the item verdict record has already been posted.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:258-270 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Telegram notification suppression checks `close_failed` but not failures recorded in `ops_failed`.
  WHY: The judge can send a success notification after an earlier actuation operation failed.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:558 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The run-ID `scan` result is not reduced to its scalar capture.
  WHY: The array-shaped result fails the numeric run-ID check, so the failing run’s log tail is not added to the judge prompt.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1879 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The spent-override `scan` result is not reduced to its scalar capture.
  WHY: The array-shaped result does not match the string IDs used by `index`, so an already-spent override can be used again.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:152-156 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `ensure_label_exists` is unavailable because the standalone judge script does not source `scripts/label_helpers.sh`.
  WHY: In consumer repositories where a required label is absent, label creation is skipped and the subsequent label-add request fails, aborting or leaving unblock actuation incomplete.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1284-1317 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The root `pr_merge_status_guard.py` differs from its template copy in resolved-source-tip handling.
  WHY: The copy-equality contract test fails, contributing to five `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` failures and a failing aggregate `lint` check.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:568-611 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Project activation verification writes to the shared `ai:operator-step` issue outside the `operator-step-writer` concurrency group.
  WHY: Its non-atomic read-modify-write can race with unblock judging or activation verification and overwrite newly added operator steps.
- scripts/unblock_scan.py:228-231 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The scan’s active-judge check does not account for pending activation-verification jobs sharing the `operator-step-writer` concurrency group.
  WHY: Dispatching a judge can replace a pending activation-verification run, which has no retry path for the merged PR.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:unblock_run_ops operator_step case | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: A failed operator-step issue upsert is logged without setting `ops_failed`.
  WHY: The judge can report successful actuation and send a notification even though the operator instructions were not written and will not be retried for that verdict.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh / scripts/unblock_actions.py / scripts/unblock_scan.py:unblock_main/reset_ops/select | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Failed actuation can remove a PR’s block label and return before posting the project verdict marker.
  WHY: The next scan no longer selects the unlabeled PR, so it cannot retry the failed dispatch or reconcile the missing project record.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The last ai-autofix commit (9de52f26) claimed to apply fixes for "closing failure handling, jq scan capture, PR trust boundary, concurrency serialisation, and test contracts."
  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh, scripts/unblock_actions.py, scripts/unblock_scan.py, .github/workflows/implement.yml, tests/test_unblock_judge.py, tests/test_unblock_scan.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/unblock_judge.sh lacks the stated failure handling, PR base binding, marker ordering, and scan capture fixes; .github/workflows/implement.yml lacks the scan capture fix; scripts/unblock_actions.py closes before replacement creation; scripts/unblock_scan.py lacks the active-judge check; the cited tests are absent.
- requirement: CI checks must pass before pull request merge.
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The root hook differs from workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py in resolved source tip SHA handling; test_template_copies_are_identical and dependent source-tip tests fail.
- requirement: CI must pass. The lint aggregate job fails because tests-hooks-and-orchestrator has 5 failed tests (171 passed).
  expected_change_site: The missing fixes in scripts/unblock_judge.sh and .github/workflows/implement.yml
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The cited CI check run failed with 5 test failures; the listed unblock-judge and workflow fixes are absent.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:355-357; 358-363 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The judge derives an issue’s tracking project from untrusted body text; for pull requests it also resolves a linked issue’s body text to derive the tracking number.
  WHY: A forged tracking line can route fix-up requests and verdict records to an unrelated project.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:170-172 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: When `create_issue` fails, `ops_failed` is not set and the operations loop continues.
  WHY: A reissue can close the source item without creating its replacement.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:247-254 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The close handler does not check for earlier failures, and a close failure sets only `close_failed`.
  WHY: The source may be closed after replacement creation fails, or a failed close may be logged as successful actuation.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:531-538 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The project tracking issue verdict marker is posted before planned operations run.
  WHY: A marker-write failure returns before the unblock action runs, although the item verdict record was already posted.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:258 (telegram handler) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The Telegram notification guard checks only `close_failed`, not `ops_failed`.
  WHY: The judge can send a success notification after a prior operation failed.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:152-156 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: `ensure_label_exists` is checked but `scripts/label_helpers.sh` is never sourced.
  WHY: Missing labels cause the label-add request to fail and abort actuation in consumer repositories.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py vs workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: root line 1284 vs template line 1309 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The root copy discards the resolved SHA and lacks the template’s resolved-source-tip handling.
  WHY: The byte-identity contract test fails, producing five test failures in the required job and blocking the aggregate `lint` check.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The last ai-autofix commit (9de52f26) claimed to apply fixes for "closing failure handling, jq scan capture, PR trust boundary, concurrency serialisation, and test contracts." The editor summary at entry[1] says changes were made to `scripts/unblock_judge.sh` to bind PR unblock fix-ups to the verified base ref, add `ops_failed` handling, and add `| .[0]` to scan captures.
  Expected change site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh lines 170, 247-254, 350-364, 531-550, 558
  Evidence of absence: The current checkout at 9de52f26 has none of these fixes. `ops_failed` is not set on create_issue failure (line 170-172), the close handler lacks a precondition check (line 247), close failure does not set `ops_failed` (lines 250, 253), the PR tracking resolution still uses untrusted body text rather than base.ref (lines 355-364), the project record is still posted before ops (lines 531-538), and the scan call at line 558 lacks `| .[0]`. The CI test `test_bulk_override_spend_and_judge_log_reference_extract_scalar_captures` is also absent from `tests/test_unblock_scan.py` (file ends at line 195 with no such function).
  SEVERITY: critical
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The `.github/workflows/implement.yml:1879` scan should have `| .[0]` appended to extract scalar comment IDs from jq scan results, as described in both the last autofix run and the preceding editor summary.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/implement.yml line 1879
  Evidence of absence: Line 1879 reads `scan("<!-- ai:unblock-override-used:v1 comment=([0-9]+) -->")])` without `| .[0]`. The grep pattern `scan.*\.\[` returns zero matches in the file.
  SEVERITY: high
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===

  PROBLEM: Issue tracking project numbers are parsed from unvalidated issue body text without checking for the `ai:orchestrator-managed` label.
  WHY: A standalone issue can pose as an orchestrator child and inject fix-up requests into the named project’s wave.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:lines 150-153 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: For
